# Assets Layout

This directory is organized around one authoritative source set and one archive layer.

## Primary Sources

- `本文抜粋.md`
  - Source-of-truth for runtime-facing hexagram and changing-line excerpt text.
- `占断抜粋.md`
  - Source for divination excerpts retained in the generated dataset.
- `高島易断占例.md`
  - Source-of-truth for reference case excerpts.
- `takashima/`
  - Source-of-truth for Takashima interpretation text.

## Archive

- `archive/honka.md`
  - Retired source for hexagram-level original text, readings, and hiragana lines.
- `archive/koji.md`
  - Retired source for changing-line original text, readings, and hiragana lines.
- `archive/`
  - Keep archived files separate from runtime-facing canonical sources.
